sentences.en: Ah, could we swap our mobile numbers next time?
sentences.zh: 啊，下次我们可以交换一下手机号吗？

sentences.en: Stop eating high-calorie foods and swap them for a healthy, balanced alternative.
sentences.zh: 别吃高热量的食物了，换成健康均衡的选择。

sentences.en: With which things do you want to swap?
sentences.zh: 你想用什么东西来交换？
